Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players of England Under-19 have made their way out to the middle. Mohammad Ishaq and Nangeyalia Kharote to open the batting for Afghanistan Under-19. Joshua Boyden will start proceedings with the ball. Here we go...
... CHASE TIME ...

Right then! Afghanistan Under-19 need 231 runs from 47 overs (DLS method) to create history and make it to the finals! England Under-19 batters have done their job and it is now upto their bowlers to defend the target. The pitch certainly has something in it for the bowlers and England Under-19 would be confident going into the chase. Who will come out on top and seal a spot in the finals? Do join us for the chase to find that out.

George Thomas is up for a quick chat. He says there were few wise words from the other partners and that helped him. Adds that the wicket started turning more as the game progressed and the spinners are playing a key role here. Tells that he backs his bowlers to defend this out.

Afghanistan Under-19 started their innings with pace bowlers and they did manage to get the early breakthrough but were also taken to cleaners in the Powerplay 1. It was just a matter of time before the spinners would be introduced into the attack and they were right on the money from the first ball. Nangeyalia Kharote got the prized scalp of Tom Prest and Noor Ahmad, who also dropped a couple of catches, got rid of Rew and Thomas. Izharulhaq Naveed also bowled well and he also managed to get into the wickets column. The spinners were exceptional right throughout the innings but it was Afghanistan Under-19 pacers who leaked a lot of runs and gave away their momentum in the end. All in all, it was a decent bowling performance from Afghanistan Under-19 but England Under-19 would be happy with what they have posted on the board, especially after where they were at the halfway stage.

England Under-19 did lose their southpaw, Jacob Bethell early on in the innings but it was George Thomas who took on Afghanistan Under-19 bowlers in the Powerplay. They lost their skipper, Tom Prest for just 18 runs and they lost wickets in quick succession after that. They were put on the back foot by Afghanistan but it was the partnership of Rehan Ahmed and George Bell which steadied things for the English side. They had a sedate start once the play resumed after the rain break and also lost the wicket of Ahmed but it was the aggressive Alex Horton and George Bell who scored at a brisk rate in the end overs which ensured that England Under-19 end on a high. They stitched together an unbeaten partnership of 95 runs off just 71 balls and this could prove to be a match-winning partnership for England Under-19.

Great recovery in the end from England Under-19 to go well-past the 200-run mark! Afghanistan Under-19 had things under their control for the majority of the innings but they will be slightly disappointed after leaking some runs at the fag end and allowing England Under-19 to get back into this contest, where at one stage, they were struggling at 106/5.

FOUR! Into the gap! Fifty as well for Alex Horton! What an innings from him as well. A length ball, on middle. Horton pulls it into the gap towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary. England Under-19 end at 231/6.
FOUR! What a shot! A length ball, outside off. Horton is early on his pull but does well to hit it wide of the fielder there at deep square leg. Boundary.
SIX! BANG! What a final over this is turning out to be! A fuller delivery, on off. Horton stays back and tonks it over long off for a biggie. He moves into the 40s.
A yorker, on middle. Horton works it to long on and the batters take a couple of runs. Really good running this from these two. Giving their all.
A full ball, on middle. Horton heaves it to deep mid-wicket for a single. The fielder there throws it quickly to the keeper who comes forward to grab it but fumbles in doing so. Another run stolen.
Slower, length and on middle. Bell hits it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Just a single! Length and on middle. Bell reverse hits it to third man for a single.
NO BALL! Sami hurls and serves a full toss, down the leg side. Bell swings across but fails to connect. The keeper dives and saves a certain boundary. No ball given for height. Free-hit coming up.
A yorker, just outside off. Bell looks to heave but misses it. The ball whizzes past the off stump.
FOUR! Cracked away! Length and outside off. Bell makes room and slashes it over covers and it races away to the fence.
Fuller and on middle. Horton digs it out to mid-wicket for a single.
Short in length, on off. Horton pulls it wide of long on and takes another couple.
Length and outside off, pulled away along the ground for a single. Fifty for George Bell, the best possible finish England would have asked for.
DROPPED! A fuller ball, slower and on off. Horton heaves it towards deep square leg. The fielder from deep mid-wicket runs across, makes a good ground but the ball pops out. Two again.
Full and outside off. Alex Horton smashes it to long off for a couple of runs. 200 up for England Under-19.
Length and outside off. Bell steps across and tucks it away to deep square leg for a quick single. Bell wanted another but was sent back. He puts in a dive to get back.
FOUR! Brilliant from Bell! A full ball, on off. Bell shuffles and scoops it over the keeper and bags another boundary. This is good finish from England.
Full and outside off, Horton looks to drive but gets an outside edge to third man for a single.
FOUR! Again a boundary to start the over! On a length, on middle. Horton comes down the track and pulls it into the gap towards deep square leg for a boundary.
Sami goes full this time, around middle. Alex Horton squeezes it out towards the deep mid-wicket region and the batters collect a run.
Banged into the deck, around off. George Bell hangs back and flat-bats it wide of long on. A single taken.
Play and a miss! Back of a length, outside off. George Bell backs away and looks to cut yet again but fails to get any bat on it.
Shorter in length, around off. Alex Horton skips down the track and pulls it without much timing wide of the long on fielder for a single. That brings up the 50-run stand between these two!
Short of a length, on off. George Bell stays back and cuts it hard. He finds the fielder at cover-point and the batters cross for a single.
FOUR! A gift from Sami, a juicy full toss, around off. George Bell backs away and cuts it past the diving fielder at point for a boundary.
A slower, loopy ball, well outside off. George Bell drags it wide of mid off and collects a run.
Short of a length, on off. Alex Horton heaves it towards deep mid-wicket and settles for only a single.
On a length, angling in from middle. George Bell looks to pull but gets cramped for room. It goes off the inner half of the blade back past the bowler towards mid on for a single.
A slower ball, fuller in length, outside off. George Bell drives but straight to the man at extra cover.
Back of a length, around off. Alex Horton heaves it towards deep mid-wicket and settles for a run.
Excellent running! Good-length ball, on middle. Alex Horton nudges it to the leg side and comes back for the second run.
Naveed Zadran is back into the attack.
FOUR! Cheeky from George Bell! A full ball, around middle. Bell shuffles across in his crease and scoops it over the short fine leg fielder to bag a boundary.
An appeal for LBW but the umpire says no! A yorker, around middle. Alex Horton looks ton dig it out but he gets an inside edge onto his pad. The ball rolls to the off side for a single.
On a length, around middle. George Bell stays back and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Good-length ball, outside off. Alex Horton skips down the track and cuts it towards deep cover. He settles for a single this time.
FOUR! CRUNCHED! Back of a length, outside off. Alex Horton hangs back and pulls it uppishly in front of square and beats the fielder at mid-wicket to fetch himself a boundary.
Short of a length, around off. George Bell hangs back and punches it down to mid off for a quick single.
Floated, fuller in length, outside off. Alex Horton drives but straight to the man at extra cover. That ends Izharulhaq Naveed's spell. He finishes with figures of 10-1-37-1.
On a length, around off. George Bell pushes it towards cover and takes off for a single.
Bye! Nicely tossed up, outside off. Alex Horton looks to sweep but he misses. The keeper fails to grab the ball and the batters sneak in a bye.
Flatter ball, darted on the pads. George Bell nudges it to the leg side and collects a run.
Tossed up, outside off. George Bell reaches out and works it behind square on the off side.
Flatter ball, around off. George Bell rocks back and keeps it out.
Short of a length, on the hips, Bell wrists it to deep square leg for a single.
Full and outside off, pushed to mid off for a quick single. Good running.
WIDE! Full and down the leg side. Horton misses his flick.
Length and on off, punched off the back foot to point for one run.
A length ball, outside off. Bell shuffles and looks to pull but misses.
Huge, huge appeal for LBW but the umpire is unmoved! On a length, on middle. Bell looks to work it on the leg side but misses and gets hit on the pads. Height might have saved him there.
Leg bye! Length and slanting on the pads. Horton looks to nudge it to the leg side but he misses. The ball hits him on the pads and the ball rolls to the leg side for a leg bye.
Bilal Sami (5-1-34-0) comes back to bowl.
Short and outside off, cut away to point for a single. Good fielding there.
A googly, on middle. Horton reads it and keeps it out.
On middle. Bell closes his bat face early as he looks to flick, gets a leading edge to covers for a single.
Full and outside off. Bell looks to slog-sweep but misses.
Flatter, straight and on middle. Bell blocks it out.
FOUR! This is full and outside off. Bell looks to drive but gets an outside edge past first slip and towards the third man fence. Much needed for England Under-19.
End of Powerplay 2! Afghanistan Under-19 can now have a maximum of 5 fielders outside the ring till the 47th over. Also, Izharulhaq Naveed (8-1-29-1) is back on.
A low dipping full toss, on off. Horton works it to point.
Full and outside off. Horton drives it through covers again, long off comes across and cuts it off. Two taken.
FOUR! Welcome boundary! This is full and outside off. Horton smashes it through the gap, through covers for a boundary.
Length ball, slower and outside off. Horton punches it to covers.
Full and on off, pushed to mid off.
Length and outside off. Bell dabs it to the right of third man for a single.
Full and outside off, this is hit to deep covers for one. End of an excellent spell from Noor Ahmad, 10-0-32-2.
On middle, driven down to long on for a single.
Another outside off delivery. Horton has a go and fails to get any bat on it. The keeper puts a half-hearted appeal there.
A huge appeal for caught behind but mostly from the keeper. Full and outside off, it skids through. Horton has a poke at it and misses.
Very full and on middle. Bell gets his bat down and squeezes it out to long on. One more.
Flatter and on middle, eased down to long on for a single.
Fuller ball, outside off. Bell leans and pushes it to covers. Excellent over for Afghanistan Under-19.
Length and outside off. Bell hops and taps it to point.
Length and on off. Bell defends it on the surface.
Leg bye! An appeal for LBW but that was clearly going down! Angles it on the pads. Horton misses his flick and gets hit on the pads. A  leg bye as it rolls to fine leg.
Full and angling on middle. Horton blocks it.
Alex Horton is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Rehan Ahmed gifts his wicket here! A full ball, outside off, Rehan Ahmed chases this wayward delivery and pushes with soft hands, uppishly and towards cover where Izharulhaq Naveed takes it. Afghanistan Under-19 are elated and this is another blow to England Under-19!
Commentary.Howout: c Izharulhaq Naveed b Naveed Zadran

Commentary.Commentary: Another googly, slightly shorter in length and around off. Bell hangs back to block it out.
Tossed up, on a length, around middle. George Bell nudges it towards mid-wicket.
Wide! A full ball, way outside off. George Bell lets it be and the umpire calls it as a wide.
Flatter and quicker, around middle. Rehan Ahmed rocks back and works it towards long on for a single.
A googly, fuller in length and outside off. Rehan Ahmed prods but lets it through to the keeper.
Tossed up, well outside off. Rehan Ahmed prods and pushes it towards cover.
A flatter ball, around off. Ahmed sits back in his crease and keeps it out.

Good running! Short of a length, around off. Rehan Ahmed hops in his crease and bunts it behind square on the off side. The keeper runs to his right, collects the ball and has a shy at his end but he misses. A single taken.
Another full ball, around middle. Rehan Ahmed flicks but finds the fielder at mid-wicket. No run there!
A bit fuller this time, jagging back in from off. Rehan Ahmed covers the line of the ball and blocks it onto the deck.
Back of a length, outside off. Rehan Ahmed hangs back and punches it to the man at cover.
On a length and angling in from outside off. Ahmed does not offer any shot to this one.
Good-length ball, outside off. Bell leans forward to block but it goes off the outside edge towards third man for a single.
Change. Naveed Zadran (3-0-18-1) is back on.
A quicker ball, darted on the pads. Rehan Ahmed stays back to flick but he misses and the ball clips his pad before going through to the keeper.
Nicely tossed up, around off. Rehan Ahmed lunges and defends it onto the deck.
Fuller in length, on middle. George Bell works it to long on and settles for a single.
Wide! A googly, on a length and way outside off. George Bell lets it through to the keeper.
Flatter ball, on a length and spinning in late. Bell tucks it to the right of the bowler.
This is a flatter ball, around middle. Bell sits back in his crease to keep it out.
Tossed up, around leg. Rehan Ahmed clips it behind square on the leg side and collects a run.
Noor Ahmad is back into the attack.
A short ball, around off. Rehan Ahmed rocks back and pulls it wide of the long on fielder for a run. George Bell wanted the second run but he is sent back by Ahmed.

FOUR! EDGY! A quicker ball, on a length and outside off. Rehan Ahmed stays back and looks to cut hard but it takes the outside egde and ricochets off the keeper's gloves and past the first slip fielder. The ball races away to the fence.
Nicely tossed up, around off. Rehan Ahmed blocks it off the front foot.
Flatter ball, on a length, around off. George Bell rocks back and works it towards long off for a run.
On a length and way outside off. George Bell leaves it alone.
Flatter ball, around off and spinning away late. George Bell stays back to block but it goes off the outside edge past the slip fielder and the batters take a couple of runs.
Tossed up, around off. Rehan Ahmed blocks it out watchfully.
Another solid block from Rehan Ahmed.
Pitches it up, on  off, Ahmed hits it on the off side.
Around off, Ahmed pushes it to the right of Nangeyalia Kharote who gets there to stop it.
Flatter and on off. Ahmed blocks it out.
Full toss, on middle, Bell works it to long on for a single.
Tossed up on middle. Ahmed prods and blocks it out.

UPDATE - 9:39 pm IST (4:09 pm GMT) The sun is out and we are minutes away from the play. We have lost three overs and that means it will be 47-overs per side contest now. The players are back on the field.

Oh, dear! The rain has gotten a bit heavier now and the umpires have asked for covers. However, there is a strong breeze blowing around at the moment and we hope that it is nothing more than a passing shower.

An appeal for caught behind but that was the ball spinning off the deck! Full ball, outside off, turning away. Rehan Ahmed swings across the line and misses it completely. There was a stumping chance but the keeper fumbled a bit and that helped Ahmed to get back inside his crease.
Short and outside off, cut away to deep point for a single.
BEATEN! This lands on off and turns away. Bell gets on the front foot to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
On middle. Blocked out.
A leg spinner, on off. Ahmed works it to backward point where the fielder does well to dive and stop it. A single.
A slight drizzle going on at the moment. Although, not enough to take the players off the field.
Flights this one, on middle. Ahmed chips it to the right of the bowler and to long on for a single.
Another single as Bell pushes this fuller ball to long on.
A single! Full ball, on middle, eased down to long on for one more.
Tossed up, on off. Ahmed keeps it out.
On middle. Blocked out.
Tossed up, fuller and on middle. Ahmed turns it to mid on.
Around off, Bell taps it to point. He wanted a quick single but was sent back wisely.
Fuller ball, outside off, driven straight to the fielder at covers.
On the pads. Ahmed rocks back and flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Another solid front foot defense from Rehan Ahmed.
Again full and on middle, this is worked to covers.
Tossed up, on middle, pushed to mid on.
Flatter and on off. Bell presses forward and blocks it out.
On off, pushed to covers.
Full and on middle, this is pushed down to long on for a single.
An arm ball, on middle, nudged to mid-wicket.
On middle, eased down to long on for a single.
Tossed up, on middle, Bell defends it solidly.
Fuller and outside off, driven to covers.
Around off, this is hit to point for a single.
Slower through the air, on off. Bell blocks on the front foot.
Touch fuller, on middle, flicked to square leg for a single.
Short and outside off, Bell slaps it to deep covers for a single.
A googly, spinning sharply onto the pads. Bell rocks back to defend but misses.
Wonderful bowling from Nangeyalia Kharote! He sees Rehan Ahmed skipping down so hurls a quicker ball, around middle. Ahmed looks to flick it but he gets an inside edge onto his pad.
A short ball, outside off. George Bell cuts it to point and takes a single.
Flatter ball, shorter in length, on middle. Rehan Ahmed hangs back and punches it down to long on for a single.
Flatter ball, around off. Rehan Ahmed lunges to defend but it goes off the inner half of the blade towards mid-wicket.
This one goes on with the arm and Rehan Ahmed gets hit on his pad as he tries to hang back and defend it. Good change-up from Nangeyalia Kharote!
Tossed up, around off and turning away late. Rehan Ahmed looks to block but it goes off the outside edge towards short third man.
A forced change as Noor Ahmad was struggling with his hamstrings and Nangeyalia Kharote is back on.
Floated, fuller in length, darted on the pads. Rehan Ahmed glances it behind square on the leg side and gets off the mark with a run.
Tossed up, on a length and outside off. Rehan Ahmed leaves it alone.
Rehan Ahmed comes in.

OUT! BOWLED! Izharulhaq Naveed strikes this time and England Under-19 lose another one! Naveed serves a googly, on a length, around middle which turns in sharply. William Luxton prods to block it out but he misses. The ball brushes his pads and goes knocks the stumps over. Terrific passage of play for Afghanistan Under-19 and they are all over England Under-19 now!
On a length, well outside off. George Bell presses forward and carves it through the cover region for a run.
Floated, fuller in length, outside off. William Luxton drills it towards long off for a single.
Tossed up, around off. William Luxton keeps it out.
An overpitched ball, outside off. William Luxton carves it through the cover region and takes a single.
BEATEN! Flatter ball, on a length, outside off and skidding onto the batter. William Luxton prods to defend but the ball beats his outside edge.
A googly, fuller in length, outside off. William Luxton drives it wide of the sweeper cover fielder and comes back for the second run.
Tossed up, around off. William Luxton keeps it out.
CUT AWAY! Slightly shorter in length, outside off. William Luxton stays back and cuts it past the diving cover fielder for a couple of runs.
Tossed up, around middle. William Luxton clips it towards mid-wicket.
Slower through the air, on a length, outside off. Bell covers the line of the ball and defends it.
Good running! Flatter ball, outside off. Luxton blocks it towards cover and scampers through to the other end.
On a length, around off. George Bell taps it to the off side and takes off for a single.
FOUR! TOP SHOT! Floated, fuller in length, outside off. George Bell leans into his extra cover drive and pierces the gap to perfection. The ball races away to the fence.
A quicker ball, on a length and outside off. Bell stays back to block but it takes the inside edge and luckily for him falls wide of the stumps.
Tossed up, around leg. William Luxton looks to defend but it goes off the inner half of the blade towards square leg for a single.
Tossed up, around middle. George Bell tucks it to the man at mid-wicket.
George Bell is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Noor Ahmad holds onto this one and gets rid of the set batter. This was a flatter ball, on a length, and turning in from middle. Thomas looks to play it across the line but it goes off the inner half of the blade straight back to the bowler. Noor Ahmad makes no mistake this time and pouches it with ease. England Under-19 lose their fourth wicket and are in a spot of bother now!
Was there an outside edge on it? Tossed up, on a length, outside off. George Thomas looks to drive but he might have got an outside edge. The keeper though fails to grab it.
BEATEN! Tossed up, well outside off. George Thomas looks for a booming drive but the ball beats his outside edge.
Another ball, darted on the pads. George Thomas keeps it out.
Flatter ball, on a length, outside off. William Luxton stays back and cuts it towards deep cover for a run.
Slower, and outside off. Thomas defends it out. Still a good over for Afghanistan.

FOUR! Good shot! Welcome boundary for England! Slightly short, on middle. Thomas pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary. Also, Fifty up for George Thomas, he is making sure the scoreboard keeps moving.
A googly now, Thomas gets hit on the pads. That was going way down.
Outside off. Thomas lunges and leaves it alone.
Wonderful bowling! Full and outside off, turning more away. Thomas prods to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge. The keeper disturbs the bails but the back foot was inside his crease.
A single as this is drilled down to long on.

This one comes back in, Thomas tucks it off the inner half to deep square leg. The fielder there covers a lot of ground and throws it to the keeper who clips the bails off but the batter runs hard to complete two runs.
A googly, turning away, on a driving length. Thomas misses his drive completely.
Way outside off, Luxton is off the mark as he drives it to sweeper cover for one.
Gives flight to this one, on middle. Luxton works it on the leg side.
William Luxton comes out to bat at number 5.

OUT! LBW! Noor Ahmad gets his man. What a lovely display of bowling from him and breaks another partnership which was looking good. This lands on middle and then turns away sharply. James Rew is on his back foot as he looks to flick but gets beaten by the turn. Gets hit on the pad and an appeal follows for LBW. An easy decision for the umpire who raises the finger.
Short and on off. Thomas punches off the back foot to long off for a single.
This is hit by James Rew on the leg side.
On middle. Rew reverse sweeps it to point.
Full and on middle. Rew thinks of sweeping it but eventually defends it down onto the deck.
Short and outside off. Rew misses his cut.
An appeal for LBW but the umpire is unmoved! Full and on middle, turning back into the left-hander. Rew prods to defend but gets beaten and hits him on the pads. Might be missing the leg stump.
Izharulhaq Naveed serves it on the pads, this is flicked to square leg. There was a direct hit at the bowler's end but the batter never left his crease.
Izharulhaq Naveed comes to bowl now.
SIX! Counter attack! A loopy ball, on middle. Thomas gets low and slog-sweeps it all the way over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Flatter now, on off. Thomas gets back and defends it on the deck.
Another appeal for LBW but turned down! This is very full and quicker as well. Thomas is late as he looks to flick and gets hit on the pads.
BEATEN! Lovely bowling! Tossed up, on off, again turning away. Thomas gets on the front foot and looks to defend but misses.
This one lands on off and turns away sharply, beats the outside edge of Thomas who looks to defend.
WIDE! Full and down the leg side. Thomas misses his whip.
An appeal for LBW but not given! A full ball, angling on middle. Thomas misses his flick and gets hit on the pads. Might be pitching outside leg.

DRINKS! England Under-19 are going along nicely even though they have lost two wickets. Afghanistan Under-19 would have been in a much better position had Noor Ahmad taken those catches. The English side need a solid partnership now while Afghanistan Under-19 will be eyeing for some wickets to stay in the contest.
Full and on off, driven through covers for a single.
Another solid defense as George Thomas gets on the front foot.
Tossed up, on middle. Defended out.
On middle, driven to the bowler who half-stops it and allows a single.
A slower one now, on the pads, tucked to square leg. Thomas wanted a single but was sent back.
FOUR! Freebie! A low full toss, on off. Rew reverse sweeps it through backward point for a boundary.
BEATEN! Lovely bowling from Noor Ahmad! A conventional leg-spinner this time, on a length and outside off. George Thomas looks to cut but he misses. Just 2 runs off the over!
Hammered but for no run! Tossed up, well outside off. Thomas drives hard but straight to the man at extra cover.
BEATEN! A googly, fuller in length, outside off. George Thomas looks to drive on the up but he misses as the ball beats his outside edge.
Slower through the air, on a length, around leg. James Rew looks to sweep but he gets an inside edge behind square on the leg side for a run.
Floated, fuller in length, outside off. George Thomas sweeps it in front of square and takes a single.
Flatter ball, around off. George Thomas punches it to the man at cover.
FOUR! Nicely done! Another ball, tossed up, outside off. Rew prods and reverse sweeps it behind square on the off side. The ball races away towards the third man fence.
Tossed up, around off. James Rew leans forward to block it.
Looped up, fuller in length, on off. George Thomas clears his front leg and drills it to long off for a single.
On a length, around off. George Thomas gets behind the line of the ball and blocks it out.
Tossed up, around off and turning away late. Thomas looks to defend but it goes off the outer half of the blade towards backward point. Well bowled!
Fuller in length, outside off. Thomas keeps it out.
Another appeal for LBW but the umpire says no! Flatter ball, fuller in length and going on with the arm. Rew lunges forward to block but he misses and gets hit on his pad.
Flatter ball, on a length, around middle. Rew defends it off the front foot.

A stifled appeal for LBW but the umpire is unmoved! A flat googly, around middle and spinning in late. Rew presses forward to defend but he misses and gets hit on his pad. That would have surely spun down leg.
Tossed up, around middle. George Thomas works it towards long on for a run.
Another googly, outside off and spinning away late. Thomas looks to defend but the ball spins past his blade. Excellent delivery!
Wide! A googly, on a length but way outside off. George Thomas lets it be and the umpire calls it a wide.
Flatter ball, darted on the pads. Rew stays back and nudges it behind square on the leg side for a single.
On a length, around middle. George Thomas presses forward and keeps it out.
Tossed up, well outside off and inviting the batter to drive. Thomas looks to drive it away from his body. It takes the outside edge and luckily for him falls short of the short third man fielder.
Halt in play. The physio is out as Nangeyalia Kharote gets hit on his fingers while stopping the ball. A bit of magic spray applied...
Nicely tossed up, around middle. Thomas drives it back to the bolwer. Nangeyalia Kharote stops it by putting in his right hand and he seems to have hurt himself in the process.
Slightly shorter in length, around leg. Rew pulls it towards deep mid-wicket and takes a run.
Flatter ball, on middle and turning in late. James Rew tucks it to the leg side.
Tossed up, outside off. George Thomas presses forward and drives it to mid off. He scampers through to the end.
A low full toss, way outside off. Rew reaches out and works it towards deep cover for a single. Just 1 run off the over!
Well bowled! Floated, fuller in length, around off. James Rew covers the line of the ball and defends it solidly.
On a length, around off. Rew blocks it towards the point region.
Flatter ball, outside off. James Rew stays back and punches it to cover.

DROPPED! Oh, dear! It is Noor Ahmad again who drops a rather simple catch! Tossed up, around middle. Thomas works it straight back to the bowler. Ahmad gets low and tries to grab it but he puts it down and the ball goes towards long on for a run.
Tosses it up, around middle. Thomas prods and tucks it towards mid-wicket.
End of Powerplay 1! Afghanistan Under-19 can now have a maximum of 4 fielders outside the ring till the 40th over. Also, Noor Ahmad comes into the attack.
Another solid block as Rew works it on the leg side. Wicket-Maiden over from Nangeyalia Kharote.
Flatter and on off. Blocked out.
Darted on the pads, tucked to square leg.
James Rew walks in at number 4.

OUT! TAKEN! Good thinking but Prest fails in his execution. The mid off was up and Prest tries to go over him but holes out. This is full and on off. Tom Prest looks to go inside out, he does and lifts it over mid off. Naveed Zadran tracks back and keeps his eyes on the ball. Takes it over his head and sends the opposition skipper back to the pavilion.
Commentary.Howout: c Naveed Zadran b Nangeyalia Kharote

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up, on off, Prest looks to defend but it goes off the outer half to point.
Full and on off, Prest keeps it out.
Another expensive over! Angles it on the pads, this is flicked to the fine leg region. One.
FOUR! Glorious drive! Full ball, outside off. Prest gets low and punches it through cover-point for consecutive boundaries.
FOUR! Controlled shot! Short, slower and outside off. Prest pulls it past mid-wicket for a boundary. That also brings up 50 for England.
Outside off, this is hit to covers for one.
Short and outside off. Thomas toe ends his slap past mid off. The fielder gives a chase and cuts it off. Two again.
Fuller and outside off. Thomas takes the charge but ends up slicing it over covers for a brace.
FOUR! All the deliveries were on the stumps and this one is outside off, Prest latches on it. Fuller and Prest carves it through point for another boundary.
Tossed up, on middle. Prest defends it out
Around off, pushed to covers.
Quicker one now, fuller and on middle. Prest gets an inside edge as he looks to push, towards short fine leg.
Angles it on a fuller delivery, on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Tossed up, on middle. Prest blocks it on the back foot.
Nangeyalia Kharote comes into the attack. Spin being introduced for the first time.
Good end to the over! Short one now, on middle. Thomas ducks under it.
Length ball, outside off. Thomas swings and misses.
TWO WIDES! Length ball, down the leg side. Prest misses his flick. The keeper does well to get a hand on it and stop from racing away. A single taken.
On the pads, flicked to mid-wicket for a  quick single.
SIX! England taking the charge now! This is short and on middle. Thomas looks to pull but gets a top edge over the fine leg fence. There was a fielder there but he was a mere spectator.
On middle, this is hit on the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Good shot! Another outside off delivery, fuller length. Prest gets low and guides it through point for a boundary.
FOUR!  Nicely driven! Good over for England as 13 runs come off it. Full and outside off. Thomas leans and drives it through covers for a boundary.
WIDE! Full and way outside off, over the tramline for a wide.
DROPPED! There was another wicket for Zadran! Length and on middle. Thomas is early as he pulls it. The ball goes straight to Noor Ahmad at short mid-wicket who gets low and fumbles to catch it.
Just over mid on! A length ball, outside off. Thomas mistimes his pull and the ball rolls over the fielder at mid on. Two.
A length ball, outside off, change of pace there, Thomas looks to cut but misses.
FOUR! Beautiful shot and this will release some pressure which was hovering around! A length ball, outside off. Thomas hammers it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Length ball, outside off, pushed through covers for a couple of runs.
Back of a length, around off. Tom Prest stays back and taps it to the off side. He yells 'WAIT'. Just 2 runs off the over!
On a length, angling in from middle. Prest lunges and works it towards mid on. No run there!
Good-length ball, just outside off and shaping away late. Prest leaves it alone. Good comeback from Bilal Sami.
Wide! Sami serves a short ball but errs in line. The ball goes down leg and the umpire signals a wide.
Full-length delivery, way outside off. Tom Prest shoulders his arms to this one.
Good-length ball, around off. Tom Prest presses forward and blocks it out.
Back of a length, around off. George Thomas taps it towards backward point and scampers through to the other end.

BEATEN! Zadran almost has two in two! He goes full again, outside off and the ball jags back in sharply. Prest prods and looks for a booming drive but the ball sneaks through his bat. End of a successful over for Afghanistan Under-19!
The skipper, Tom Prest walks out to the middle.

OUT! LBW! Naveed Zadran strikes and this is a massive wicket for Afghanistan Under-19! Zadran serves a full ball, around middle which nips back in just that little bit. Jacob Bethell looks to play it across the line and he misses it completely. He gets rapped on his pad and Zadran appeals. The umpire takes her time and raises her dreaded finger. Huge blow this for England Under-19!
Zadran goes fuller this time, outside off. George Thomas prods and drives it towards mid off. The fielder there moves across to his left and stops it. A single taken.
Short of a length, way outside off. Thomas looks to cut hard through the point region but the ball zips past his outside edge.
On a length, around off. George Thomas gets solid in his front foot defence.
Back of a length, around middle. Jacob Bethell pulls it wide of the mid on fielder without much timing and takes a run.
NASTY! Sami serves a short ball, around middle. George Thomas looks to duck under it but the ball hurries onto him and he gets hit high on his body.
On a length, outside off. Thomas looks to cut but the ball stays a bit low and sneaks through his bat.

A stifled appeal for caught behind but the umpire says no! Good-length ball, around the fourth stump channel and shaping away late. George Thomas looks to block but the ball beats his outside edge. Lovely bowling from Sami.
BEATEN! Another ball, back of a length, outside off. George Thomas looks to go over mid off this time but does not get any bat on it.
FOUR! UP AND OVER! Good-length ball, around middle. George Thomas stands tall and whips it over the mid on fielder. The ball races away to the fence.
Back of a length, angling in from middle. George Thomas looks to flick but he misses and gets hit high on his pad.
An appeal for LBW but turned down by the umpire! Good-length ball, around leg. Jacob Bethell looks to defend but he misses and gets hit high on his pad. That woud have certainly pitched outside leg.
On a length, around off. Thomas prods and pushes it wide of the mid off fielder for a single. Both the openers are off the mark now!
Play and a miss! Short of a length, outside off. George Thomas hangs back and looks to cut hard but he does not get any blade on it.
Short of a length, around leg. Bethell hops in his crease and nudges it to the leg side with soft hands. He gets off the mark with a run.

Wide! A wayward ball, angling across the batter and well outside off. Jacob Bethell misses his cut shot and the umpire signals a wide. First runs on the board for England Under-19, courtesy a wide from Zadran.
Good-length delivery, on off and shaping away a bit. Bethell looks to defend but it takes the outside edge and goes towards the gully fielder, on the bounce.
Back of a length, around off. Jacob Bethell stays back and punches it to the man at cover.
Who will start from the other end? It is Naveed Zadran.
BEATEN! Good-length ball, around off and curling away late. Thomas stays back to block but the ball swings past his outside edge. Sami starts off with a maiden over! Top start!
On a length, just outside off and nipping back in just that little bit. Thomas looks to drive on the up but he gets an inside edge onto his pad. Five dots in a row!
This is a length ball, angling in late from middle. George Thomas looks to flick but he misses and gets hit on his thigh pad.
Play and a miss! Back of a length, outside off. George Thomas hangs back to cut but he fails to get any bat on it.
Good-length ball, around off. Thomas looks to defend but it goes off the outside edge and falls just short of the gully fielder.
Sami starts with a length ball, outside off. George Thomas leaves it alone. Some movement early on for Sami!

It is time for action. Suliman Safi is giving the last pep talk before the players take their respective positions. George Thomas and Jacob Bethell are the openers for England. Bilal Sami to start with the ball. Let's play ...

UPDATE - Good news folks! The covers are taken off and we are all set for the action but before that the players line up for their respective national anthems. It is Afghanistan's first followed by England's. Done with the proceedings.

UPDATE - 6:25 pm IST (12:55 pm GMT) - Not the kind of news that we were hoping for, folks! The rain has returned and out come the covers yet again. England players' are keeping themselves busy by playing football while Afghanistan players' are hanging around. We wait for an official word...

England Under-19 (Unchanged playing XI) - George Thomas, Jacob Bethell, Tom Prest (C), James Rew, William Luxton, George Bell, Rehan Ahmed, Alex Horton (WK), James Sales, Tom Aspinwall, Joshua Boyden.

UPDATE - 6:04 pm IST (12:34 pm GMT) - The toss has been delayed due to rain. The good news is that it has stopped raining now and the toss will take place at 6:15 pm IST (12:45 pm GMT).

England Under-19 are a solid unit and have some exciting talented youngsters in their ranks. Their skipper, Tom Prest is the second-highest run-getter of this tournament but having said that, they have plenty of other match-winners in their lineup as well. The English side does have a lot of variety in their bowling attack and they will be keen to put on another spirited performance in this semi-final. We are in for a mouth-watering contest as both teams will push hard for a place in the finals. Stay tuned for toss and team news.

Afghanistan Under-19, led by Suliman Safi, were brilliant in the quarter final and it was their bowlers who put on a show against Sri Lanka Under-19 to hand them a defeat. They have a quality bowling attack but their batters will need to step up in this semi-final as nothing comes easy in such knockout games. Afghanistan Under-19 will be high on confidence coming into this semi-final and they will be eager to carry on with the winning momentum.

Hello and a very warm welcome to the coverage of Semi-Final 1 of the U-19 World Cup between England Under-19 and Afghanistan Under-19. Both these teams fought hard in the league games, the quarter final and now they'll be itching to come out on top in this game and book their spot in the summit clash. Sir Vivian Richards Stadium in Antigua is all set to host this exciting semi-final and it will be interesting to see which team makes it to the final of this tournament.
